subject: Social Media
title: Connected but Alone
description: Learn Connected but Alone in one minute.

hook.text: Average Americans have 300 online friends and report the highest loneliness rates in history.

buildup.text: Sherry Turkle warned in 2012: we're 'alone together'—surrounded by connections, starved of connection.

discovery.text: Online interaction lacks cues real bonding needs: touch, shared space, eye contact, physical presence.

twist.text: Heavy social media users report more loneliness than light users. The relationship is dose-dependent.

climax.text: Loneliness has health effects equal to smoking 15 cigarettes daily. Social media may be a public health crisis.

punchline.text: More connected. More alone. Both are true.

quiz.question: What health risk is loneliness comparable to?
